programs.description: Gowri Lakshmi Bayi entrusts the four-month-old Swathi Thirunal Rama Varma to the care of the English East India Company.
Bobby leads a carefree life until his former lover arrives at his place with a baby girl claiming she is his daughter. However, Bobby must find the truth behind her claims.
After his thesis gets rejected and he gets expelled from his college, the idealistic Sreekumar is left with no choice but to take up menial jobs in a pigsty.
Manjula, a transgender woman in Kerala, faces daily challenges in a conservative society. Her journey of self-acceptance and resilience unfolds against evolving social norms.
When Unnimol, a young girl child, faces dismissal from all her relatives and community, Lord Ayyappan takes the form of a school student to help her overcome obstacles.
Rich girl, Sosamma, elopes with Babu, a poor painter, as her parents are against their relationship. The two face many challenges when they shift to a new city for a living.
CID officer Chandran is murdered while working on a challenging case. Officer Nazir takes over, determined to solve both Chandran's murder and the original case.
When Ravishankar, a journalist, learns that he has blood cancer, he gets depressed and loses all hope of living. However, his life changes for the better when he meets a friend, who is a doctor.

A young woman faces constant torment and oppression from her family, but remains resilient in her search for love and happiness.
A father's decision to remarry brings unexpected struggles as his son Sethumadhavan steps up to care for his half-sisters, navigating shifting family relationships.
Sridevi leads a peaceful and happy life with her husband, Balakrishnan, and his siblings. However, the family faces various adversities that challenge their bonding.
Though separated, a husband and wife still love each other but hide their true feelings out of fear of rejection. They are then forced to confront their emotions or risk losing each other forever.
When the past of a middle-aged unmarried businessman confronts him, it affects his unusual romantic relationship with a younger girl.
Kalyani, who is speech impaired, is disliked by everyone in her family, except her mother. As she longs for her father's affection, Kiran enters her life.
Kalyanakrishnan marries his girlfriend Mary, but they lie about her religious background to his traditionalist Hindu Brahmin family. Every moment thereon becomes a challenge.

Kochubaby and Mary, a visually impaired duo, fall in love and get married. Unfortunately, she dies in an accident, and he struggles to look after their only daughter.
Frustrated by systemic corruption, a group of friends creates an interactive website to take complaints from the common man, transforming themselves into vigilantes dedicated to safeguarding society.

Rajan, a policeman, goes after a powerful criminal but ends up losing his wife and is also left crippled. Soon, he becomes a jailer and recruits four vigilantes to trap the kingpin who ruined his life.

V. P. Sathyan, a professional Indian footballer, goes through various ups and devastating downs in his career as he strives hard to fulfil his ambitions.
